name: Outcast
description: Outcast is a singleplayer third-person action-adventure game and the first in the Outcast series.
notes: This is the 'Outcast 1.1' listing — a 2014 official update to the classic 1999 game. 2017's 'Outcast: Second Contact' and 2024's 'Outcast: A New Beginning' are separate games.
